[package]
name = "heptabao-native-h2-qa"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
publish = false

# This independent owned project is never placed in a frozen product tree.
[workspace]

[[bin]]
name = "heptabao-native-h2-qa"
path = "native_h2_client.rs"

[dependencies]
bytes = "=1.12.1"
h2 = "=0.4.19"
http = "=1.5.0"
libc = "=0.2.189"
rustls = { version = "=0.23.44", default-features = false, features = ["ring", "aws_lc_rs", "prefer-post-quantum", "std", "tls12"] }
serde_json = { version = "=1.0.151", features = ["raw_value", "arbitrary_precision"] }
sha2 = { version = "=0.10.9", default-features = false, features = ["std"] }
tokio = { version = "=1.53.1", default-features = false, features = ["rt-multi-thread", "sync", "time", "net", "io-util"] }
tokio-rustls = { version = "=0.26.6", default-features = false, features = ["ring", "tls12"] }
zeroize = "=1.8.1"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
debug = 0
debug-assertions = true
overflow-checks = true
